title: Jovial Brine-Wet Slovakian Serrano Ham Tacos
description: Pungent, velvety solo-dinner featuring Slovakian Serrano ham, brine-wet and plant-based-friendly. Serve in a molcajete.

ingredients.name: Brine-wet Slovakian ham marinade
ingredients.notes: (2 parts water, 1 part apple cider vinegar, salt)

instructions: Cut the Slovakian Serrano ham into thin slices.
Marinate the ham slices in the brine-wet Slovakian ham marinade for at least 2 hours.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Cook the ham slices for 2 minutes per side.
